assessment.actual_public_bytes: Helper calls the same derive_non_approval_artifacts used by public derive_artifacts and the entire public derive_target vector. SHA-256 and byte_length are computed from contents.as_bytes(), including metadata newline and all UTF-8 bytes. No JSON-only or path-filtered shadow renderer supplies pins. Integration/helper tests independently compare public output strings, lengths, counts and per-file facts.
assessment.sets_and_producers: BTreeMaps sort descriptors by exact output path. Duplicate paths reject within either producer; cross-producer overlaps reject. Producer tags distinguish metadata_and_audit from bun_target, regardless of path prefix. SQL, persistence entities, lifecycle audits and runtime dependency audit are correctly target-owned. Hashing never implies runtime/execution or release authority.
assessment.self_exclusion: derive_artifacts calls approval, whose snapshot calls the helper; helper uses only no-approval producer plus derive_target, avoiding recursion. pin rejects approval/ paths, excluded JSON/text are explicit, and public assembly restores them at indices8/9. Existing seed exact-order test passed. These exclusions are not blanket permission to omit other outputs.
assessment.unsupported_vs_absent: A checked scheduled-job project retains metadata/audit/jobs.json while target records generation_rejected with JADPO_TARGET_JOB_NOT_IMPLEMENTED/toolchain.target_job_not_implemented and no target pins. Successful fresh generation is separately labelled; no successful-empty-target assertion is fabricated.

The complete provenance also participates in state/subject digests. Independent CLI recomputation matched subject/behavior/state/manifest hashes. Fresh export conformance rejected rehashed target-pin omission and digest replacement in own integration tests. Additive open-object provenance does not itself require a v5 canonicalization change; no issuer or attestation acceptance was added.
